why_relevant: The only CSO systematically monitoring the Procurement Review Body (OSHP) since 2016; publishes case-level reports on blocked/re-evaluated procedures with euro values, and flags integrity failures in award decisions.

source_name: Preportr / Kosovo Center for Investigative Journalism (QKGH), part of Organizata Cohu
why_relevant: Investigative magazine specialised in public-contract forensics: has analysed hundreds of tenders worth hundreds of millions of euro, naming beneficial owners and political links. Its archive is a ready-made map of which companies repeatedly win state contracts.
Parent NGO of Preportr; tracks asset declarations of public officials and the performance of the Anti-Corruption Agency - the standard route to establishing conflicts of interest behind an award.

source_name: Kosovo Democratic Institute (KDI) - Instituti Demokratik i Kosoves
why_relevant: Transparency International's national contact in Kosovo; produces the 'Index of Transparency in Public Procurement' scoring ministries on publication of procurement plans, tender notices and appeals - a structural read on where documents will and will not be findable.

source_name: Agjencia per Parandalimin e Korrupsionit (APK) - Anti-Corruption Prevention Agency
why_relevant: State integrity body that reviews procurement activities of all budget organisations, intervenes to stop unlawful tenders and publishes those interventions plus officials' asset declarations - the authoritative counterpart to CSO allegations and a source of named cases.

source_name: Nova drustvena inicijativa / New Social Initiative (NSI) - northern Kosovo procurement monitoring
why_relevant: Publishes assessments of municipal spending in the four Serb-majority northern municipalities (North Mitrovica, Zvecan, Leposavic, Zubin Potok) covering competition levels, single-bidder tenders and contract concentration - the only systematic Serbian-language procurement watchdog output for that territory, where banking/payment access is itself contested.

source_name: NVO ACDC (Advocacy Center for Democratic Culture) - 'Javne nabavke na severu Kosova'
why_relevant: Serbian-language CSO running a dedicated project on public procurement functionality in the four northern municipalities, aimed at transparency and local SME participation; a primary route to Serbian-language procurement terminology and local actor names.

source_name: Alternativna.com - Serbian-language investigative/analysis portal covering Kosovo
why_relevant: Carried the detailed write-up of the northern-municipalities procurement assessment (single-bidder rates, contract concentration, cancelled tenders); acts as the distribution layer for Serbian-language watchdog findings that never appear in Albanian media.

source_name: NVO Aktiv (Mitrovica North) - Serb-community governance watchdog
why_relevant: Leading Serb-community research NGO on institutions and governance in Kosovo; a pointer to Serbian-language actor names, municipal spending research and community-level access-to-finance issues. Note it has itself been the subject of political targeting, so treat framing carefully.

source_name: Balkan Insight (BIRN regional) - Kosovo procurement & finance coverage
why_relevant: English-language regional publication of BIRN investigations; useful for cross-border stories where a bank, payment processor or IT vendor operates in several Western Balkan markets, and for the annual BIRN awards listing which name notable Kosovo procurement investigations.

Publishes document-led stories alleging unlawful tender awards by state-owned enterprises, naming officials and beneficiary firms; low institutional credibility but occasionally first to publish underlying contract documents.

source_name: Kosovo Law Institute (IKD) - Instituti i Kosoves per Drejtesi
why_relevant: Monitors prosecution and adjudication of corruption cases, including procurement-fraud indictments; the bridge between a watchdog allegation about a contract and whether it ever became a criminal case.
